text: The compiled selected-OLS foundation is implemented in native Ols.scala, OlsEstimates.scala and OlsEstimatesSuite.scala after baseline-safe synchronization from /private/tmp/plsneuro-selective-providers-1. Shared JVM and Scala.js OlsSuite plus OlsEstimatesSuite each pass 23 tests (log /private/tmp/plsneuro-selective-ols-tests-2.log). Evidence includes independent exact-rational estimates/covariance/SSE, nuisance annihilation, permutation/scaling, strided blocks, exact-determined estimates without residual df, explicit rank/policy failures and existing full-fit compatibility. Pinned Gale d55fe2f97196a76ab7879e1a12f1e92403aeba06 supplies public pivoted QR applyQ/applyQT and triangular solves; no generic kernel copied into ScalaFIM. The hot execute method forwards the caller's Backend capability. Estimates-only preparation does not compute crossproduct/normalized covariance; execution does not compute full betas, nuisance maps, residuals or standard errors. This is an uncommitted foundation, not completion of the native issue or consumer admission. Structural bounded-dataset API tests are running in the isolated candidate; real FIR/transform/fallback and performance/consumer acceptance remain required.
